description: ARCEP- Zones Fibre Optique GPS is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP. Au titre de l’analyse de marché des accès de haute qualité [1], l’Autorité régule, notamment, les tarifs des offres de gros d’Orange sur fibre optique dédiée ( BLOD ). Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Télecommunications. Its keywords are zone fibre optique, zone FO. The portal shows 23 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
